name: ros2-x11-pulseaudio-smoke
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -eu; ros2 pkg prefix rviz2 >/dev/null; command -v colcon >/dev/null; command -v rosdep >/dev/null; command -v vcs >/dev/null; test "${PULSE_SERVER}" = unix:/tmp/devcontainer-pulse/native; test -e /tmp/devcontainer-pulse/native; test -n "${DISPLAY:-}"; echo "ROS 2, X11, and PulseAudio forwarding are available."'
